packet.headline_seed: VisionQuest trailer kicks off Disney's D23 fan event
packet.description_seed: It was a busy first day at D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event, in Anaheim, California, with Marvel Studios releasing the first trailer for VisionQuest . We also got the first teaser for Ahsoka S2; the public release of the Avengers: Doomsday special footage featured last month for attendees only at San Diego Comic-Con; a special sneak peek (for attendees only) for Star Wars: Starfighter ; casting news for the MCU's X-Men movie; and a trailer for an animated special, LEGO Star Wars: The Mandalorian , coming to Disney+ next month. (Some spoilers below. One MAJOR spoiler for Spider-Man: Brand New Day ; we'll give you a heads-up when we get there.) VisionQuest Marvel's streaming TV portfolio has kind of been all over the place: a handful of hits, a few misses, and a bunch of middling offerings. One of the standout hits was WandaVision , followed by an excellent sequel (of sorts), Agatha All Along . VisionQuest will complete the trilogy. Yes, Vision (Paul Bettany) died in Infinity War , but WandaVision resurrected an all-white version whose memories were restored in the finale. We finally get to learn what happened afterward. Read full article Comments

It was a busy first day at D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event, in Anaheim, California, with Marvel Studios releasing the first trailer for VisionQuest. We also got the first teaser for Ahsoka S2; the public release of the Avengers: Doomsday special footage featured last month for attendees only at San Diego Comic-Con; a special sneak peek (for attendees only) for Star Wars: Starfighter; casting news for the MCU’s X-Men movie; and a trailer for an animated special, LEGO Star Wars: The Mandalorian, coming to Disney+ next month. (Some spoilers below. One MAJOR spoiler for Spider-Man: Brand New Day; we’ll give you a heads-up when we get there.)

Marvel’s streaming TV portfolio has kind of been all over the place: a handful of hits, a few misses, and a bunch of middling offerings. One of the standout hits was WandaVision, followed by an excellent sequel (of sorts), Agatha All Along. VisionQuest will complete the trilogy. Yes, Vision (Paul Bettany) died in Infinity War, but WandaVision resurrected an all-white version whose memories were restored in the finale. We finally get to learn what happened afterward.

Paul Bettany's android Avenger will return in October. The upcoming Marvel Cinematic Universe series "VisionQuest" got its first trailer during Friday's D23 Disney Entertainment Showcase. The new show premieres on Disney+ on Wednesday, Oct. 14. It will be the final part in the trilogy that began with 2021's "WandaVision" and continued with 2024's "Agatha All Along," according to Marvel Studios. D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event is the company's biennial exposition, where it previews upcoming movies, shows, experiences and products, in addition to honoring its history. This year's event is taking place at the Anaheim Convention Center from Friday to Sunday. "VisionQuest" will see Paul Bettany returns as android Avenger Vision. James Spader will also appear in the series as villainous artificial intelligence Ultron, whom he last played in 2015's "Avengers: Age of Ultron."

Vision, rebooted and having escaped from those who sought to weaponize him, has been in hiding. Searching for new meaning, he consults the AI personas embedded in his programming, including F.R.I.D.A.Y., E.D.I.T.H., J.A.R.V.I.S., and the infamous Ultron. His discreet existence ends when a bounty placed on his head thrusts him on the run with Thomas Shepard, a mysterious boy who may be Vision’s son, reincarnate. As Vision evades capture, he must confront his nature, resist Ultron’s influence, and unravel the enigma that is his young companion if he’s to survive.

Naturally Bettany is returning as Vision, along with James Spader as Ultron. Agatha All Along gave us a new Billy Maximoff, whose soul took over the dying body of another teen as Wanda’s spell unraveled at the end of WandaVision. Fans may recall that Agatha helped Bill track down the soul of his twin, Tommy (aka Speed), and place him into the body of a teen boy who drowned, Thomas Shepherd. That storyline is clearly getting picked up in VisionQuest, since Ruaridh Mollica has been cast as Tommy/Thomas Shepherd. Bettany said last year that the series would explore “intergenerational trauma” with fathers and sons.

[Lähde: ABC7 New York | URL: https://abc7ny.com/post/visionquest-trailer-brings-1st-look-marvel-show-d23/19684131/]
Paul Bettany's android Avenger will return in October.

The upcoming Marvel Cinematic Universe series "VisionQuest" got its first trailer during Friday's D23 Disney Entertainment Showcase.

The new show premieres on Disney+ on Wednesday, Oct. 14.

It will be the final part in the trilogy that began with 2021's "WandaVision" and continued with 2024's "Agatha All Along," according to Marvel Studios.

D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event is the company's biennial exposition, where it previews upcoming movies, shows, experiences and products, in addition to honoring its history. This year's event is taking place at the Anaheim Convention Center from Friday to Sunday.

"VisionQuest" will see Paul Bettany returns as android Avenger Vision. James Spader will also appear in the series as villainous artificial intelligence Ultron, whom he last played in 2015's "Avengers: Age of Ultron."

D23 LIVE UPDATES: Here's every major announcement from Disney's ultimate fan expo

Along with Orla Brady, the cast also includes Henry Lewis, Jonathan Sayer, James D'Arcy, Emily Hampshire and Ruaridh Mollica.

We last saw a rebuilt Vision in the "WandaVision" series finale -- the character was destroyed prior to that appearance in "Avengers: Infinity War" -- where his memories of his time as an Avenger were restored, and he flew off to an unknown destination.

Speaking to ABC News at New York Comic Con last October, Bettany said "VisionQuest" will find his character searching for identity.

"We meet Vision at a point where he is trying to figure out who he is and what he's for," he said. "There is a lot of philosophical debate between me and James Spader. There's a lot of philosophical stuff, but with lasers."

Bettany said he believes that search is key to the character's popularity.

"The wonderful thing about the Vision and why he appeals to young people so much is that he is in the process of becoming," he said. "You always find him in a process of discovering, or at least trying to discover, who he is. And I think that's an urgent business for young people."

Marvel is owned by Disney, parent company of ABC News and "Good Morning America."

payload.title: Marvel julkaisi VisionQuest-sarjan ensimmäisen trailerin D23-tapahtumassa
payload.summary: Paul Bettany palaa Visionin rooliin lokakuussa alkavassa Disney+-sarjassa, joka päättää WandaVisionista alkaneen trilogian.
payload.content:
Marvel Studios julkaisi VisionQuest-sarjan ensimmäisen trailerin Disneyn D23-fanitapahtuman avauspäivänä Anaheimissa Kaliforniassa. Perjantain Disney Entertainment Showcase -esityksessä esitelty tuotanto saa ensi-iltansa Disney+-palvelussa keskiviikkona 14. lokakuuta. Paul Bettany palaa androidi Visionin rooliin, ja sarja päättää Marvel Studiosin mukaan WandaVisionista alkaneen kolmiosaisen tarinan. Traileri antaa samalla ensimmäisen katsauksen tulevaan Marvel Cinematic Universe -sarjaan.

## WandaVisionista alkanut tarina päättyy

Trilogia käynnistyi vuonna 2021 WandaVision-sarjalla ja jatkui vuonna 2024 Agatha All Alongilla. VisionQuest on kokonaisuuden kolmas ja viimeinen osa. Sarjojen muodostama jatkumo ulottuu siten vuoden 2021 aloituksesta lokakuussa julkaistavaan päätösosaan. Uuden sarjan lähtökohta palauttaa huomion WandaVisionin tapahtumiin ja Visionin avoimeksi jääneeseen kohtaloon.

Vision kuoli Avengers: Infinity Warissa, mutta WandaVision toi tarinaan hänen kokonaan valkoisen versionsa. Tämän Visionin muistot palautettiin WandaVisionin päätösjaksossa. VisionQuest kertoo, mitä muistinsa takaisin saaneelle hahmolle tapahtui sen jälkeen. Bettany palaa siis juuri sen Visionin rooliin, jonka seuraavat vaiheet jäivät aiemmassa sarjassa näyttämättä.

James Spader esiintyy VisionQuestissa pahantahtoisena Ultron-tekoälynä. Spader näytteli Ultronia edellisen kerran vuonna 2015 ilmestyneessä Avengers: Age of Ultron -elokuvassa. Bettanyn ja Spaderin roolit tuovat samaan sarjaan kaksi aiemmista MCU-tuotannoista tuttua hahmoa: androidi Visionin sekä tekoäly Ultronin. Uusi tuotanto jatkaa samalla WandaVisionin jälkeistä tarinalinjaa.

## D23:ssa esiteltiin useita Marvel- ja Star Wars -tuotantoja

D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event on Disneyn joka toinen vuosi järjestämä näyttelytapahtuma, jossa yhtiö esittelee tulevia elokuvia, sarjoja, elämyksiä ja tuotteita sekä kunnioittaa omaa historiaansa. Tämänvuotinen tapahtuma järjestetään Anaheim Convention Centerissä perjantaista sunnuntaihin. VisionQuestin traileri oli yksi avauspäivän useista ohjelmanumeroista, ja samana päivänä esiteltiin sisältöä sekä Marvelilta että Star Warsista.

Marvelin sarjan lisäksi tapahtumassa julkaistiin Ahsokan toisen kauden ensimmäinen ennakkovideo. Julkisesti nähtäväksi tuotiin myös Avengers: Doomsdayn erikoismateriaalia, joka oli näytetty edelliskuussa vain San Diego Comic-Conin osallistujille. D23-osallistujille esitettiin erillinen ennakkokatsaus Star Wars: Starfighterista. Päivän ohjelmaan kuuluivat lisäksi Marvelin tulevan X-Men-elokuvan roolitusuutiset ja LEGO Star Wars: The Mandalorian -animaatioerikoisen traileri. Animaatioerikoisen on määrä saapua Disney+-palveluun ensi kuussa.

Marvel’s streaming TV portfolio has kind of been all over the place: a handful of hits, a few misses, and a bunch of middling offerings. One of the standout hits was WandaVision, followed by an excellent sequel (of sorts), Agatha All Along. VisionQuest will complete the trilogy. Yes, Vision (Paul Bettany) died in Infinity War, but WandaVision resurrected an all-white version whose memories were restored in the finale. We finally get to learn what happened afterward.

Vision, rebooted and having escaped from those who sought to weaponize him, has been in hiding. Searching for new meaning, he consults the AI personas embedded in his programming, including F.R.I.D.A.Y., E.D.I.T.H., J.A.R.V.I.S., and the infamous Ultron. His discreet existence ends when a bounty placed on his head thrusts him on the run with Thomas Shepard, a mysterious boy who may be Vision’s son, reincarnate. As Vision evades capture, he must confront his nature, resist Ultron’s influence, and unravel the enigma that is his young companion if he’s to survive.

Naturally Bettany is returning as Vision, along with James Spader as Ultron. Agatha All Along gave us a new Billy Maximoff, whose soul took over the dying body of another teen as Wanda’s spell unraveled at the end of WandaVision. Fans may recall that Agatha helped Bill track down the soul of his twin, Tommy (aka Speed), and place him into the body of a teen boy who drowned, Thomas Shepherd. That storyline is clearly getting picked up in VisionQuest, since Ruaridh Mollica has been cast as Tommy/Thomas Shepherd. Bettany said last year that the series would explore “intergenerational trauma” with fathers and sons.

[Lähde: ABC7 New York | URL: https://abc7ny.com/post/visionquest-trailer-brings-1st-look-marvel-show-d23/19684131/]
Paul Bettany's android Avenger will return in October.

The upcoming Marvel Cinematic Universe series "VisionQuest" got its first trailer during Friday's D23 Disney Entertainment Showcase.

The new show premieres on Disney+ on Wednesday, Oct. 14.

It will be the final part in the trilogy that began with 2021's "WandaVision" and continued with 2024's "Agatha All Along," according to Marvel Studios.

D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event is the company's biennial exposition, where it previews upcoming movies, shows, experiences and products, in addition to honoring its history. This year's event is taking place at the Anaheim Convention Center from Friday to Sunday.

"VisionQuest" will see Paul Bettany returns as android Avenger Vision. James Spader will also appear in the series as villainous artificial intelligence Ultron, whom he last played in 2015's "Avengers: Age of Ultron."

D23 LIVE UPDATES: Here's every major announcement from Disney's ultimate fan expo

Along with Orla Brady, the cast also includes Henry Lewis, Jonathan Sayer, James D'Arcy, Emily Hampshire and Ruaridh Mollica.

We last saw a rebuilt Vision in the "WandaVision" series finale -- the character was destroyed prior to that appearance in "Avengers: Infinity War" -- where his memories of his time as an Avenger were restored, and he flew off to an unknown destination.

Speaking to ABC News at New York Comic Con last October, Bettany said "VisionQuest" will find his character searching for identity.

"We meet Vision at a point where he is trying to figure out who he is and what he's for," he said. "There is a lot of philosophical debate between me and James Spader. There's a lot of philosophical stuff, but with lasers."

Bettany said he believes that search is key to the character's popularity.

"The wonderful thing about the Vision and why he appeals to young people so much is that he is in the process of becoming," he said. "You always find him in a process of discovering, or at least trying to discover, who he is. And I think that's an urgent business for young people."

Marvel is owned by Disney, parent company of ABC News and "Good Morning America."

article.summary: Paul Bettany palaa Visionin rooliin lokakuussa alkavassa Disney+-sarjassa, joka päättää WandaVisionista alkaneen trilogian.
article.content:
Marvel Studios julkaisi VisionQuest-sarjan ensimmäisen trailerin Disneyn D23-fanitapahtuman avauspäivänä Anaheimissa Kaliforniassa. Perjantain Disney Entertainment Showcase -esityksessä esitelty tuotanto saa ensi-iltansa Disney+-palvelussa keskiviikkona 14. lokakuuta. Paul Bettany palaa androidi Visionin rooliin, ja sarja päättää Marvel Studiosin mukaan WandaVisionista alkaneen kolmiosaisen tarinan. Traileri antaa samalla ensimmäisen katsauksen tulevaan Marvel Cinematic Universe -sarjaan.

## WandaVisionista alkanut tarina päättyy

Trilogia käynnistyi vuonna 2021 WandaVision-sarjalla ja jatkui vuonna 2024 Agatha All Alongilla. VisionQuest on kokonaisuuden kolmas ja viimeinen osa. Sarjojen muodostama jatkumo ulottuu siten vuoden 2021 aloituksesta lokakuussa julkaistavaan päätösosaan. Uuden sarjan lähtökohta palauttaa huomion WandaVisionin tapahtumiin ja Visionin avoimeksi jääneeseen kohtaloon.

Vision kuoli Avengers: Infinity Warissa, mutta WandaVision toi tarinaan hänen kokonaan valkoisen versionsa. Tämän Visionin muistot palautettiin WandaVisionin päätösjaksossa. VisionQuest kertoo, mitä muistinsa takaisin saaneelle hahmolle tapahtui sen jälkeen. Bettany palaa siis juuri sen Visionin rooliin, jonka seuraavat vaiheet jäivät aiemmassa sarjassa näyttämättä.

James Spader esiintyy VisionQuestissa pahantahtoisena Ultron-tekoälynä. Spader näytteli Ultronia edellisen kerran vuonna 2015 ilmestyneessä Avengers: Age of Ultron -elokuvassa. Bettanyn ja Spaderin roolit tuovat samaan sarjaan kaksi aiemmista MCU-tuotannoista tuttua hahmoa: androidi Visionin sekä tekoäly Ultronin. Uusi tuotanto jatkaa samalla WandaVisionin jälkeistä tarinalinjaa.

## D23:ssa esiteltiin useita Marvel- ja Star Wars -tuotantoja

D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event on Disneyn joka toinen vuosi järjestämä näyttelytapahtuma, jossa yhtiö esittelee tulevia elokuvia, sarjoja, elämyksiä ja tuotteita sekä kunnioittaa omaa historiaansa. Tämänvuotinen tapahtuma järjestetään Anaheim Convention Centerissä perjantaista sunnuntaihin. VisionQuestin traileri oli yksi avauspäivän useista ohjelmanumeroista, ja samana päivänä esiteltiin sisältöä sekä Marvelilta että Star Warsista.

Marvelin sarjan lisäksi tapahtumassa julkaistiin Ahsokan toisen kauden ensimmäinen ennakkovideo. Julkisesti nähtäväksi tuotiin myös Avengers: Doomsdayn erikoismateriaalia, joka oli näytetty edelliskuussa vain San Diego Comic-Conin osallistujille. D23-osallistujille esitettiin erillinen ennakkokatsaus Star Wars: Starfighterista. Päivän ohjelmaan kuuluivat lisäksi Marvelin tulevan X-Men-elokuvan roolitusuutiset ja LEGO Star Wars: The Mandalorian -animaatioerikoisen traileri. Animaatioerikoisen on määrä saapua Disney+-palveluun ensi kuussa.
